title: Sales & CS Arsenal for Dedicated Autoscale: Battlecards, FAQ, Talk Tracks, Demo Scripts
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Purpose: Produce a compact, battle-tested set of enablement assets for Sales and Customer Success to drive rapid adoption of the Dedicated Autoscaling feature. Assets should reduce ramp time, answer common objections, and provide reproducible demo steps that highlight economic and reliability benefits for enterprise customers.

Scope: 1) One-page battlecards for AE/SE, 2) FAQ for reps and CS playbooks, 3) Short talk tracks (30s/90s) for discovery and demo contexts, 4) Two canonical demo scripts (AE technical and CS onboarding flow), 5) One-pager ROI calculator inputs and sample talking points, 6) Training plan and slide deck for the Sales All-Hands.

Target audience: AEs, SEs, CS managers, onboarding specialists, and partner reps.

Success metrics: enablement assets published in Drive and Confluence, at least 3 live demo recordings produced, enablement session attended by 80% of quota-carrying AEs, and post-training confidence survey average >= 4/5.
acceptance_criteria: Battlecard PDF (AE & SE versions) uploaded to Drive and linked in Confluence
FAQ doc with 25+ validated Qs/As and CS troubleshooting steps
Two demo scripts (technical demo ~10 mins, onboarding flow ~8 mins) with checklist and test data
30s and 90s talk tracks in a single-slide cheat sheet
ROI one-pager with sample numbers and talking points
Training slide deck and recording posted; live session scheduled and attended
PM notes and launch links added to release notes coordination checklist

rollout_plan: Week 1: Finalize assets and record demo videos. Week 2: Host two live enablement sessions (global-friendly times), post recordings and one-sheet to Confluence. Week 3: 1:1 office hours for top 10 strategic accounts; share feedback and iterate assets. Ongoing: monitor AE adoption via enablement survey and GTM channel; feed common questions back to product and docs.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Engineering numbers change before release -> Mitigation: Lock benchmark snapshot and mark 'subject to change' in living docs; update slides during RC week.
Risk: AEs skip training -> Mitigation: Short mandatory 20-minute recorded module + optional live Q&A; provide incentives via leaderboard.
Risk: Demo data variability across customer environments -> Mitigation: Provide both synthetic test data and a checklist for customers to reproduce key scenarios.
